_schema._about: Pointers and page metadata for /privacy and /terms. The page agent renders the two markdown sources into the reference legal template: a white page, eyebrow 'Legal', display h1, a 'Last updated' line, then a single ~720px column of prose with each '## ' heading as a section. The legal wording is the owner's published text and is not to be edited or re-cased by the renderer. British English.
_schema.pages: {<key>: {path, title, description, h1, eyebrow, last_updated, source, theme}} - source is the absolute path of the markdown file to render.
_schema.render: {strip, features, links, tables, case} - what the markdown renderer must handle. strip lists the leading lines to drop (the page supplies its own h1 and last-updated line).
_schema.related: [{label, href}] - the two legal pages cross-link each other in a small row under the h1.
_schema.contact: {email, href} - repeated at the end of each page under a 'Contact' heading if the source lacks one (both sources have one).

privacy.title: Privacy policy | hypjam
privacy.description: How hypjam handles personal data on this site: what we collect when you get in touch, the services involved, your UK GDPR rights, and how to reach us.

terms.title: Terms and conditions | hypjam
terms.description: The terms that apply when you use the hypjam website: who we are, what you can and can't do with the site and its content, disclaimers, liability and law.

strip: the first '# ' heading (the page renders its own h1)
the '**last updated: ...**' paragraph (the page renders last_updated in its own style)
features: | pipe tables | (privacy.md, section 'third parties we rely on')
render.links: External links open in a new tab with rel=noopener noreferrer; links to /privacy, /terms or mailto stay in the tab.
render.tables: Render pipe tables as a real <table> inside an overflow-x:auto wrapper; the page body never scrolls sideways.
render.case: The sources are written in lowercase throughout. Render them exactly as written; do not sentence-case legal text.
